model.rationale: Huffman is a well-funded incumbent in a D+13 district, while Robin Littau has shown no measurable fundraising or outside support, and markets price the race at 99% Democratic. Nothing in the evidence justifies moving off the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected outside spending against Huffman would be the first sign of movement, though none is currently evident.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
North Coast CA-02 is a strongly Democratic district, and Jared Huffman is seeking another term as its incumbent. He has raised nearly $1 million and holds more than $1 million on hand, while Republican Robin Littau reports no fundraising figures and draws no outside spending on either side. Prediction markets give Huffman a 99% chance of winning.

With no public general-election polls and no expert ratings, the forecast leans on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided money picture. All point to a comfortable Democratic win, with the main uncertainty being the usual wide error band in low-information races rather than any specific threat to Huffman.
